description: Calculate the full cost of a UK bridging loan: total interest, arrangement and exit fees, valuation/legal/admin costs, gross facility, net advance, loan-to-value, total cost of finance and an indicative annualised cost. Supports rolled-up (compounding), retained (deducted upfront) and serviced (paid monthly) interest. Also runs the FCA MCOB 3A high net worth check: on a regulated bridge, an applicant with annual net income of at least GBP 300,000 OR net assets of at least GBP 3,000,000 can have a term up to 60 months instead of the standard 12-month cap. Calculated by Fox Davidson, whole of market UK mortgage brokers authorised and regulated by the FCA (FRN 1056214). Use when a user asks what a bridging loan costs, about bridging interest (rolled-up, retained or serviced), bridging LTV, regulated vs unregulated bridging, or the maximum term on a regulated bridge.

add_arrangement_fee_to_loan.description: Whether the arrangement fee is financed into the gross loan (true) or paid separately in cash (false).

additional_funds_gbp.description: Additional cash required beyond clearing existing charges, in pounds.

admin_fees_gbp.description: Admin and other fees in pounds.

annual_net_income_gbp.description: Optional. Borrower annual net income, used for the MCOB 3A high net worth term check. GBP 300,000 or more passes the income limb.

arrangement_fee_pct.description: Lender arrangement fee as a percentage of the loan.

existing_charges_gbp.description: Existing mortgages or loans the bridge will repay, in pounds.

exit_fee_on_gross.description: Whether the exit fee is charged on the gross loan (true) or the net loan (false).

exit_fee_pct.description: Exit fee as a percentage, charged on redemption. Often 0.

interest_structure.description: 'rolled' compounds monthly and is paid at exit. 'retained' deducts the full term of interest from the advance upfront. 'serviced' is paid monthly. Retained and serviced cost the same; rolled-up costs more.

legal_fees_gbp.description: Lender and borrower legal fees in pounds.

monthly_rate_pct.description: Monthly interest rate as a percentage, for example 0.75 for 0.75% per month.

net_assets_gbp.description: Optional. Borrower net assets including main residence equity and pension, minus all debts, used for the MCOB 3A high net worth term check. GBP 3,000,000 or more passes the net assets limb.

property_value_gbp.description: Open market value of the security property in pounds.

regulated.description: True if the bridge is secured against a property the borrower lives in or intends to live in (regulated). False for investment or commercial security (unregulated).
